succession-stages.alt: Two rows of stages. Primary succession: bare rock with no soil, lichens and mosses as pioneer species, grasses on thin soil, shrubs, fast-growing trees, mature forest (climax community); it starts after lava cools or a glacier retreats and is slow. Secondary succession: soil remains after a fire or farm, grasses and weeds as pioneer species, shrubs, fast-growing trees, mature forest; it is faster because soil and seeds remain.
